summary: Maps Nile control domains across Azure and GCP. This pack enforces only the metadata-presence obligation that can be checked from Terraform plan JSON; remaining governance intent and review-stage requirements are process-only in this document.

input_schema.description: Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json). Policies read resource_changes[].change.after tags/labels.

controls.title: Metadata present on planned resources
controls.source_section: Section 4 – Control Matrix – Metadata; Section 9 – StackGen Validation Guidance – Metadata
controls.obligation: Ownership, cost, repo, service, and APM metadata must be present and validated on governed resources.
controls.iac_check: For create/update resource_changes, require non-empty after.tags or GCP after.labels/resource_labels/node_config[].labels/settings[].user_labels keys owner, cost-center, repo, service, apmid when tag/label maps exist.

controls.title: Source of truth is GitHub-reviewed IaC
controls.source_section: Section 4 – Control Matrix – Source of Truth; Section 9 – Source control
controls.obligation: IaC must be reviewable through GitHub.
controls.iac_check: Repository review workflow is not inferable from Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Controls applied at highest practical scope
controls.obligation: Controls are applied at the highest practical scope and inheritance is documented.
controls.iac_check: Highest practical scope and documentation requirements are architectural/process concerns not determinable from a single plan.

controls.title: Avoid local/shared credentials
controls.obligation: Identity posture should avoid local/shared credentials.
controls.iac_check: Credential-sharing posture is not generically derivable from this document via Terraform plan JSON alone.

controls.title: Least privilege and auditable access reviewed
controls.obligation: Least privilege and auditable access must be reviewed.
controls.iac_check: Review and audit completeness are process outcomes, not generic plan-only checks for this matrix.

controls.title: Reduce compute exposure and control admin access
controls.obligation: Compute posture should reduce exposure and control admin access.
controls.iac_check: This matrix lists exemplars but not a concrete universal resource-attribute requirement to enforce from this doc alone.

controls.title: Private-first networking posture
controls.obligation: Public exposure must be reviewed and unintended public access avoided.
controls.iac_check: The matrix expresses intent across many services but does not define a single portable Terraform-plan rule in this document.

controls.title: Protect data from public exposure and enforce encryption
controls.obligation: Encryption and public-exposure posture must be reviewed.
controls.iac_check: This matrix references multiple downstream standards; concrete encryption/TLS checks belong in service-specific packs.

controls.title: Centralized telemetry operational
controls.obligation: Logging and monitoring posture must be reviewed.
controls.iac_check: Operational telemetry completeness is not inferable from a generic Terraform plan in this matrix pack.

controls.title: Security findings routed and monitored
controls.iac_check: Monitoring and response routing are operational/process controls, not plan-only checks here.

controls.title: Recoverability within objectives
controls.source_section: Section 4 – Control Matrix – Backup and Recovery
controls.iac_check: Recovery objectives and backup review status are not directly testable from this matrix via Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Security posture reviewed before production
controls.obligation: Vulnerability review must be completed before production.
controls.iac_check: Review completion is process-only and this document does not define plan-level attributes.

controls.title: Kubernetes guardrails required
controls.iac_check: This matrix does not specify concrete Kubernetes plan fields to evaluate in a portable way.

controls.title: Approved regions only
controls.iac_check: Allowed-region values are referenced but not enumerated in this document for direct policy evaluation.

controls.title: Controlled, traceable deviation
controls.obligation: Exceptions require owner, rationale, approval, and expiration.
controls.iac_check: Exception workflow fields are process metadata outside Terraform plan JSON and must not be invented.

controls.title: Human approval remains mandatory
controls.source_section: Section 3 – Relationship to Project Nile; Section 9 – Human approval
controls.obligation: Human approval is required for production-impacting changes.
controls.iac_check: Pull request approval state is external workflow evidence, not a Terraform plan field.
